extends SceneTree

func _initialize() -> void:
	_bootstrap.call_deferred()

func _bootstrap() -> void:
	await process_frame
	_build()
	quit()

func _build() -> void:
	var root_node := Node2D.new()
	root_node.name = "nav_world"
	root_node.script = load("res://scripts/NavWorld.gd")

	var region := NavigationRegion2D.new()
	region.name = "Region"
	root_node.add_child(region)
	region.owner = root_node

	var agent := CharacterBody2D.new()
	agent.name = "Agent"
	agent.position = Vector2(80, 300)
	agent.script = load("res://scripts/NavAgent.gd")
	root_node.add_child(agent)
	agent.owner = root_node

	var nav_agent := NavigationAgent2D.new()
	nav_agent.name = "NavigationAgent2D"
	agent.add_child(nav_agent)
	nav_agent.owner = root_node
	nav_agent.path_desired_distance = 20.0
	nav_agent.target_desired_distance = 20.0

	var col := CollisionShape2D.new()
	col.name = "CollisionShape2D"
	col.shape = RectangleShape2D.new()
	agent.add_child(col)
	col.owner = root_node

	var obstacles := Node.new()
	owner
	obstacles.name = "Obstacles"
	root_node.add_child(obstacles)
	obstacles.owner = root_node

	var obs1 := NavigationObstacle2D.new()
	obs1.name = "Obstacle1"
	obs1.position = Vector2(400, 300)
	# Rect obstacle that blocks the corridor vertically.
	obs1.vertices = PackedVector2Array([
		Vector2(-50, -180),
		Vector2(50, -180),
		Vector2(50, 180),
		Vector2(-50, 180)
	])
	obstacles.add_child(obs1)
	obs1.owner = root_node

	var obs2 := NavigationObstacle2D.new()
	obs2.name = "Obstacle2"
	obs2.position = Vector2(600, 300)
	obs2.vertices = PackedVector2Array([
		Vector2(-50, -180),
		Vector2(50, -180),
		Vector2(50, 180),
		Vector2(-50, 180)
	])
	obstacles.add_child(obs2)
	obs2.owner = root_node

	var goal := Marker2D.new()
	goal.name = "Goal"
	goal.position = Vector2(720, 300)
	root_node.add_child(goal)
	goal.owner = root_node

	var packed := PackedScene.new()
	packed.pack(root_node)
	var err := ResourceSaver.save(packed, "res://scenes/nav_world.tscn")
	if err != OK:
		printerr("Failed to save scene: ", err)

- `start_navigation()` — sets the agent destination.

NavAgent.gd`** — agent logic:
- Reads `get_next_path_position()` only once
`NavigationServer2D.map_get_iteration_id` is non-zero (stale-data guard

), integrates velocity with `move_and_slide()`.
- Flips a `reached` boolean exactly when `Navigation
Agent2D.target_reached` fires (guarded by a pending-goal check so the start-position target

doesn't trip it).

ot_project --script res://tests/run_tests.gd` returns all `[PASS]`, including the obstacle
